description: This file defines a PHP class `TimesheetMenuConfigurator` that implements the `MenuConfigurator` interface. It configures menu behavior for the timesheet section within the OrangeHRM system, utilizing various traits and services to determine the correct screen to display based on request parameters and user role.

classes.name: TimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for configuring the display and behavior of timesheet-related menu items in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the screen for the timesheet menu based on request parameters and user role. Determines whether to show the employee's own timesheet or another view based on the current request's 'id' attribute.
